templates.text: Thank you for contacting PIIK Kenya. Your reference is {{enquiry_id}}. We will review your enquiry. Please do not send identity documents, title deeds or bank details.
You can begin with our free property checklist and relevant authority guides. An independent advocate can advise on your specific transaction. PIIK does not verify ownership or transaction safety.
Our diaspora guide can help you plan independent site checks, professional advice and payment safeguards. Please tell us the general topic you need help with; avoid sensitive records.

Thank you for your interest in the proposed multidisciplinary network. Interest does not create membership, certification, endorsement or a guarantee of introductions. The founder will review proposed next steps.
Thank you for sharing your question. The founder will review the topic and decide whether PIIK can help or point you to a suitable independent resource.

This enquiry needs founder review. Do not provide legal findings, accuse any person, confirm ownership, promise a refund or disclose personal records. Refer the sender to qualified independent help where appropriate.
